title: How Salon Automation Adds Value to Your Beauty Business

facts.fact: The Meevo blog article 'The Salon Automation Map: Where Technology Adds Value' is dated October 21, 2025.
Meevo states that its online booking lets clients book salon appointments 24 hours a day, 7 days a week through a booking assistant.
facts.unit: hours per day, days per week
